why.title: Why DocoPDF?
why.subtitle: Honest, private, and built mobile-first for India.
why.privateDesc: Device-only tools never send your files anywhere. What's yours stays yours.
why.fastDesc: No upload wait — processing happens on your own device, even offline.
why.freeDesc: No signup, no watermarks, no hidden limits on device tools. Ever.

modes.title: Two honest modes
modes.subtitle: Every tool tells you exactly where your file goes — nothing hidden.
modes.deviceDesc: The whole job runs in your browser using Web Workers. Your file never touches the network.
modes.devicePoint1: Merge, split, compress, sign, edit and much more
modes.devicePoint2: Works offline once installed as an app
modes.devicePoint3: Zero upload time — great for batches
modes.serverDesc: Only for jobs a browser can't do well (like Office ↔ PDF). Files are deleted immediately after processing — never stored.
modes.serverPoint1: Deleted right after the job (15-minute fail-safe)
modes.serverPoint2: No file names or contents in any log
modes.serverPoint3: Clear limits: 10 free server tasks per day

pro.title: Pro is coming
pro.body: Paid features arrive in a later phase. Device-only tools will always stay free — that's a promise.

footer.trust: Most tools run inside your browser. Your files stay on your device.
footer.phaseNote: DocoPDF is being built in phases — the design system is live, tools are next.
